text: MAT-A001: Consolidated Industries v. Premier Metals Corp. Breach of supply agreement. Settled for $1.2M after 14 months of litigation. Discovery revealed defendant's capacity constraints were foreseeable.
MAT-A002: Johnson v. Apex Staffing Solutions. Age discrimination under ADEA. Jury verdict for plaintiff, $380,000. Key evidence: internal emails referencing 'fresh energy' as hiring criterion.
MAT-A003: Harrison Park Condominiums construction defect. Settled pre-trial for $2.8M. Engineering report identified systematic waterproofing failures in all 45 affected units.
MAT-A004: Redwood Financial Group corporate restructuring. Converted from LLC to Delaware corporation. Completed shareholder agreement, bylaws, and tax election. Transaction value: $0.
MAT-A005: State v. Bergman. DUI defense. Client acquitted at trial. Breathalyzer calibration records showed device out of certification. Expert testimony on testing protocol failures.
MAT-A006: McKenzie Trust v. First Federal Bank. Breach of fiduciary duty by co-trustee bank. Settled for $450,000 plus bank resignation as co-trustee. Trust assets restored.

MAT-A007: Coastal Properties waterfront zoning appeal. Successfully obtained variance for mixed-use development on 5-acre waterfront parcel. Planning commission approval after environmental impact mitigation.

MAT-A008: Rivera Medical Group partnership dissolution. Four-partner medical practice dissolved by mutual agreement. Assets distributed per partnership agreement. Non-compete provisions enforced for 2 years.

MAT-A009: Apex Technology patent infringement. Defendant's motion for summary judgment granted. Court found patent claims anticipated by prior art. Key prior art reference: IEEE publication from 2018.
MAT-A010: Henderson commercial lease negotiation. Successfully negotiated 15-year lease for flagship retail location. Tenant improvement allowance: $2.1M. Rent escalation capped at 2.5% annually.
MAT-A011: Greenfield Organics Series A financing. $12M round led by HealthTech Ventures. Preferred stock with 1x liquidation preference. Board seat for lead investor.
MAT-A012: Pham v. City Transit Authority. Personal injury from bus collision. Settled for $425,000. Contingency fee of $140,250. Client net recovery: $218,750 after expenses.
MAT-A013: CrossBorder Logistics customs penalty negotiation. Successfully reduced CBP penalty from $850,000 to $125,000. Implemented prospective compliance program with quarterly audits.
MAT-A014: Digital Arts Collective trademark registration. Secured federal trademark registration for 'DAC GALLERY' in Class 041 (Entertainment Services). No oppositions filed.
MAT-A015: Sterling Bank regulatory examination. Successfully resolved OCC examination findings. Corrective action plan implemented for BSA/AML program deficiencies. No formal enforcement action.
MAT-A016: Morrison family prenuptial agreement. Executed prenuptial agreement for David and Jennifer Morrison prior to 2019 marriage. Separate property provisions for pre-marital assets.
MAT-A017: Hartwell Industries prior EPA consent decree. 2020 consent decree for groundwater contamination at former Plant B site. Remediation cost: $3.4M. Monitoring period: 5 years.
MAT-A018: Pacific Coast Airlines slip and fall defense. Summary judgment granted for airline on passenger injury claim in terminal. Court found no notice of wet floor condition.
MAT-A019: AutoTech Industries product recall advisory. Advised on voluntary recall of 45,000 brake sensor assemblies. NHTSA coordination completed. No injuries reported. Recall cost: $8.2M.
MAT-A020: Pinnacle Industries SEC reporting advisory. Quarterly SEC reporting engagement for 2023 fiscal year. Form 10-Q and 10-K review and certification support.
MAT-A021: Community Health Foundation nonprofit formation. Established 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization. IRS determination letter obtained. State charitable registration in 8 states.
MAT-A022: Cascade Holdings refinancing. $45M commercial mortgage refinancing with favorable terms. Interest rate reduced from 6.2% to 4.8%. 10-year term with interest-only period.
MAT-A023: NorthStar Energy FERC rate case. Successfully obtained favorable rate adjustment from FERC for pipeline tariff. Rate increase approved: 8.5% effective Q1 2024.
MAT-A024: BlueOcean Shipping vessel acquisition. Purchase of MV Pacific Horizon, 28,000 DWT bulk carrier. Purchase price $18.5M. Marshall Islands flag registration. Mortgage documentation.
MAT-A025: Lee v. Southwest Regional Hospital. Medical malpractice defense. Jury verdict for defendant hospital. Defense expert testimony on standard of care proved decisive.

MAT-A026: Clearwater Hospitality franchise expansion. Negotiated 5 new franchise agreements in Florida and Georgia markets. Aggregate investment: $42M. Area development agreement for Southeast region.
MAT-A027: Innovex Biotech licensing agreement. Exclusive license of CRISPR delivery technology to major pharma company. Upfront payment: $5M. Milestone payments up to $45M. Royalty: 4-6%.
MAT-A028: Sunbelt Construction subcontractor dispute arbitration. AAA construction arbitration. Award: $340,000 to subcontractor for unpaid change orders. Firm represented general contractor.
MAT-A029: Blackstone Ventures Fund II wind-down. Orderly wind-down of $180M venture fund at end of 10-year term. Final distributions to LPs. GP clawback calculation resolved.
MAT-A030: Cedar Rapids ISD prior bond issuance. $30M GO bonds for athletic facility improvements. Closed September 2022. Bonds rated AA by S&P. Tax-exempt status confirmed.
MAT-A031: Evergreen Insurance subrogation recovery. Recovered $890,000 from negligent third party after $1.2M fire loss payment. Recovery ratio: 74.2%.

MAT-A032: Phoenix Solar environmental permits. Obtained all required environmental permits for 200MW solar farm. Section 404 wetland permit, endangered species consultation, and county conditional use permit.
MAT-A033: Oakmont Partners Fund III formation. $850M PE fund. Delaware LP with Cayman feeder. Side letter negotiations with 15 institutional LPs. ILPA-compliant terms.

MAT-A034: National Medical Devices Alliance FTC consent order. Resolved FTC investigation into industry standard-setting practices. Consent order with 5-year reporting obligation. No monetary penalty.
MAT-A035: Heritage Vineyard Estate wine distribution agreement. Negotiated exclusive distribution agreement with Pacific Wine Distributors for CA, OR, WA markets. 5-year term with volume minimums.
MAT-A036: Cornerstone Capital Management SEC examination. Responded to SEC Division of Examinations compliance review. No deficiency findings. Best practices recommendations implemented.

MAT-A037: Pacific Rim Trading force majeure dispute. Resolved supply chain dispute with Chinese manufacturer citing COVID-related force majeure. Negotiated revised delivery schedule and 12% price adjustment.
MAT-A038: Silverton Mining water rights litigation. Obtained priority water rights determination for mining operations. State engineer approved appropriation of 2,400 acre-feet annually.

MAT-A039: Brightpath Education accreditation defense. Successfully defended against accreditation revocation proceedings. Accreditor placed institution on probation with 18-month corrective action plan.

MAT-A040: TechVault Systems prior data incident. 2023 security incident involving unauthorized access to development environment. No customer data exposed. Incident response and regulatory notifications.
MAT-A041: Zenith Pharmaceuticals FDA advisory. NDA supplement for expanded indication of oncology therapeutic. FDA approved supplemental application. Market launch for new indication.

MAT-A042: Quantum Computing Research IP portfolio audit. Comprehensive audit of 12 patents, 8 pending applications, and trade secret inventory. Identified 3 lapsed maintenance fees requiring immediate payment.
MAT-A043: Barrett Trust 2022 tax planning. Trust tax return preparation and filing. Generation-skipping transfer tax analysis. Trust accounting to beneficiaries.

MAT-A044: Meridian Technologies employment handbook update. Comprehensive revision of employee handbook for compliance with new state laws. Remote work policies, pay transparency, and leave provisions.

MAT-A045: Atlas Capital Partners prior acquisition. Acquired 30,000 sq ft industrial property in Windsor CT for $4.1M. Closed November 2023. Environmental Phase II required remediation escrow of $250K.
MAT-A046: Summit Healthcare Associates HIPAA compliance program. Implemented comprehensive HIPAA privacy and security compliance program. Risk assessment, policy development, and workforce training.
MAT-A047: TechForward Inc. seed round financing. $4M seed round from angel investors and micro-VC. SAFE notes with $20M valuation cap. Board advisory agreements for 2 investors.
MAT-A048: Maple Street Condominiums HOA governance reform. Revised condominium declaration and bylaws. Implemented electronic voting. Updated insurance requirements and reserve study.
MAT-A049: Cornerstone Digital Media trademark portfolio. Registered 4 trademarks in Classes 035, 041, and 042. Opposed 1 confusingly similar mark before TTAB. Opposition sustained.

MAT-A050: GlobalTech Industries FCPA internal investigation. Board-directed internal investigation into allegations of improper payments to foreign officials in Southeast Asian operations. Voluntary disclosure to DOJ.
